versions.name: LDRC2SIM-1.1.0
versions.notes: Drive the simulator from your phone, like the RXV2 receiver does: new RealFlight and neXt buttons on the home page open a controls & views screen — RealFlight gets big Select/Cancel/Up/Down/Reset buttons (HID buttons 1-8, also fired by receiver channels 9-16, e.g. a TX switch on ch10 = Reset) plus its camera/view keys; neXt gets its own key set (New model, Engine, Pause...). The adapter is now a USB keyboard as well as a joystick, so the phone can send any simulator keyboard shortcut — all keys editable per simulator, saved on the phone. One re-calibration may be needed in the sim (the joystick gained buttons). On a Mac, allow the sim in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Input Monitoring.
